ig_caption:
Sun, Nov 8: 3,685 deer reported statewide (2,926 antlered, 759 antlerless). Season total: 90,756.

Up north, Roscommon, Presque Isle and Oscoda leaned hardest antlerless on Sunday: antlerless deer were 44%, 40% and 38% of their new reports, about double the 21% statewide.
